hero.headline: Where local work becomes មីបឋម.
hero.description: In Kampong Speu, our factory, warehouse and support teams work together to build the daily operations behind our products.
hero.imageAlt: Illustrative image of noodle production; not the LM Manufacturing factory

introText: Our Kampong Speu site brings together manufacturing, storage, office and support functions in one operation. Each area has a practical role in keeping daily work organized and moving forward.

facilities.title: Factory
facilities.text: The main area where our team carries out manufacturing and daily production activities.

facilities.title: Warehouse
facilities.text: A dedicated space for organizing materials and finished products that support daily operations.

facilities.title: Office & support
facilities.text: Where teams coordinate people, information and the support needed to keep operations moving.

capabilitiesText: As the business grows, we are developing the people, processes and manufacturing capability needed to support consistent operations in Cambodia.
qualityText: Consistency starts with careful everyday work, clear procedures and attention at each stage of the operation.
safetyText: Our progress depends on people working together, following clear responsibilities and improving the way work is done over time.
